style_when: the story turns on one physical thing — a part, a material, a component, a document — and what that thing costs, contains or crosses a border is the news

subject: a server logic board with a tangled, glowing bypass wire looping back onto itself

caption: Runaway retry loops turn transient faults into costly, duplicated side effects.
